name: submitCampaign
inputs: Unknown campaign input; owner comes from requireUser.
outputs: ActionResult with queued campaign identity or safe validation/business failure.
effects: Admits campaign budget, commits campaign through createCampaign, dispatches events, revalidates workspace paths.
callers: Compose invokes this authenticated action; Inngest publication failures are caught after commit.

name: createCampaign
inputs: Authenticated userId and unknown input parsed by campaignSchema.
outputs: Existing/new campaign ID, selected count and skipped count.
effects: Locks owner, reads access/template/contacts/history, creates immutable Send snapshots and reserves daily/monthly capacity.
callers: submitCampaign; also directly exercised by campaign/database tests.

name: deliverOne
inputs: Owner UUID and Send UUID.
effects: Checks fresh controls, prepares credentials/PDF/MIME, claims usage, makes at most one submission and settles or retains accounting.
callers: sendEmail step; test callers exercise failure boundaries.

name: gmailForUser
inputs: Owner ID.
outputs: Restricted messages.send client plus sender email/name.
effects: Reads User, decrypts refresh token and performs provider access-token preparation; clears refresh credentials from send client.
callers: deliverOne. Failures occur before final send claim.

name: buildMime
inputs: Sender, recipient, subject/body, stable Message-ID and optional PDF bytes.
outputs: Promise of a base64url MIME string.
effects: Constructs in-memory text/HTML/attachment parts; sets date; composer URL/file fetching is disabled.
callers: deliverOne and MIME tests.

name: withUsageTransaction
inputs: Prisma client, owner ID and async work callback.
outputs: The callback result, or propagated error after bounded retryable DB failures.
effects: Starts short transaction, locks owner, brands valid transaction context; retries only retryable database work.
callers: Campaign, delivery, cancellation and reconciliation helpers. Network calls must stay outside work.

name: reserveUsage
inputs: Locked owner context, period specs, stable send/delivery identities and enforcement flag.
effects: Ensures/locks periods, checks full-batch capacity, creates only proven-unsubmitted reservations and refreshes counters.
callers: createCampaign; internal database primitive rather than authenticated action.

name: claimUsage
inputs: Locked owner, delivery key, current period specs, enforcement flag and time.
outputs: Claimed boolean and reservation including claim token.
effects: Checks availability/periods, rebinds unattempted reservation, records attempt time and two-minute lease on reservation/Send.
callers: Final check in deliverOne. A non-RESERVED identity cannot be submitted again through this claim.

name: confirmUsage
inputs: Locked owner, delivery key, claim token, provider acceptance IDs and sent time.
effects: Validates claim and acceptance, marks accounting CONFIRMED and linked Send SENT/DONE, rebuilds counters.
callers: Delivery settlement and durable acceptance recovery.

name: releaseUsage
inputs: Locked owner, delivery key, proof of UNSUBMITTED or matching DEFINITE_REJECTION, optional time.
outputs: Released reservation or existing released row.
effects: Rejects invalid proof; releases capacity, finalizes linked Send and refreshes counters.
callers: Cancellation, delivery failure and reconciliation. Uncertain work is not refundable through an unsubmitted assertion.

name: markUsageUncertain
inputs: Locked owner, key, claim token, time and optional expired-lease-only guard.
effects: Requires the exact claim; marks ambiguity, leaves accounting retained and updates Send FAILED/UNCERTAIN.
callers: deliverOne and lease reconciliation.

name: resolveUsagePeriods
inputs: Entitlement user and a valid instant.
outputs: Half-open daily/monthly specs with stable keys and operational boundaries.
effects: Pure calculation; throws when an active provider period is unresolved.
callers: Campaign allocation, claims, entitlement-related accounting. Free uses calendar months; actual paid access uses exact provider periods.

name: getEffectivePlan
inputs: Current entitlement-user fields and time.
effects: Pure resolution: deletion/suspension, active override, grandfathering, then subscription lifecycle.
callers: Server entitlement projection, policy and usage-period calculation.

name: canUser
inputs: Entitlement user, feature, control row or null, optional time.
outputs: Allowed decision or bounded denial code.
effects: Pure decision using lifecycle and pause helpers; does not mutate the account.
callers: requireEntitlement, client projection, createCampaign and worker checks.

name: requireEntitlement
inputs: Authenticated caller-supplied owner ID, feature and optional transaction.
effects: Reads current owner and global controls; caller still owns resource checks and locking.
callers: Actions/business operations, never a substitute for authentication.

name: encryptToken
inputs: Plaintext token and owner UUID.
effects: Reads keyring and generates random IV; generic safe error on failure.
callers: Auth.js token persistence and rotation. No database write itself.

name: decryptToken
inputs: Stored envelope and owner UUID.
outputs: Plaintext token or constant safe error.
effects: Uses selected v2 key/AAD or legacy v1 key; no implicit fallback for v2.
callers: gmailForUser, revocation workflow and key rotation.

name: rotateTokenPage
inputs: Optional apply, after UUID and bounded page size.
effects: Dry-run reads and decrypts; apply re-encrypts using ciphertext/state compare-and-swap, covering retained deletion credentials.
callers: Rotation CLI. It is not called by the handbook.

name: billingConfig
inputs: Environment name/value map, defaulting to process.env.
outputs: Validated explicit mode, API/product/webhook/business config and canonical origin.
effects: Pure validation; rejects mode/origin/override mistakes with BillingError.
callers: Billing client, ingress, checkout and scheduled jobs.

name: ensureBillingBinding
inputs: Short owner-locked transaction.
effects: Locks SystemControl and binds only a clean database; rejects environment/business mismatch or existing unbound provider data.
callers: Checkout, provider lifecycle/recovery operations.

name: verifyBillingProduct
inputs: Configured product/business.
effects: Reads provider product and localized prices; checks exact recurring catalog shape.
callers: Checkout readiness. Network calls are outside owner-lock assumptions for binding.

name: storeBillingEvent
inputs: Exact raw body, verified payload and webhook ID.
effects: Validates business, normalizes/quarantines/ignores, hashes payload and upserts by unique webhook ID; conflicts fail.
callers: Verified Dodo webhook route before after() processing.

name: processBillingEvent
inputs: Internal inbox receipt ID.
outputs: Processing outcome from the lifecycle workflow.
effects: Reads durable receipt and provider evidence; commits reconciled subscription/payment observations and retry/failure state.
callers: Webhook after() and billing recovery. Read full source for event-specific branches.

name: activateResume
inputs: Owner, validated storage path and client filename.
effects: Reads/validates PDF, locks owner, creates/selects attachment metadata, discards invalid activation and cleans eligible older files.
callers: Local upload and verified Blob completion.

name: cleanupAttachments
inputs: Owner ID.
effects: Locks owner, marks up to ten eligible files retired, deletes bytes outside transaction, then records physical completion; failure remains pending.
callers: Resume activation and accountMaintenance.

name: requestAccountDeletion
inputs: Authenticated owner and exact confirmation email.
effects: Marks account unavailable, creates independent recovery job, clears normal credential, cancels eligible READY work and attempts billing-only recovery.
callers: Account deletion action in launch-actions.ts.

name: exportAccount
inputs: Authenticated owner ID.
effects: Reads owner-scoped data with explicit projections; does not include refresh-token material.
callers: Authenticated export route with an export budget.

name: requireAdmin
inputs: Boolean selecting mutation freshness checks.
outputs: Verified admin actor with auth timestamp.
effects: Reads session, validates restricted database privileges and current actor; throws denied/unavailable/reauth codes.
callers: Admin views and actions. Mutations require fresh Google reauthentication.

name: consumeBudgets
inputs: Owner/actor ID and named budgets.
outputs: Admission result or structured denial/unavailable error.
effects: Uses database time and stable budget row locks; records admissions before business work.
callers: Protected billing/actions/export/admin entrypoints.

name: canReadGmail
inputs: No arguments.
effects: No side effects.
callers: Compatibility reply helpers and capability checks. Scope/env changes cannot enable mailbox reading.
